sale_price.meaning: Current source sale price per order item

completed_value.rule: sale_price on current Complete item rows; not recognised net accounting revenue

returned_value.rule: sale_price on current Returned item rows

contribution.rule: completed sale_price minus eligible nonnegative catalogue cost on the SAME known-cost rows
contribution.denominator: completed sale_price on those same known-cost rows

business_origin.note: Authenticated warehouse data may still be training or generated data. Row count does not establish real business origin.

greenweez.order_grain: One source order key; uniqueness must be checked before joins

logistics_and_shipping_cost.meaning: Source log_cost and ship_cost as stored

operational_component_subtotal.rule: turnover - purchase_cost + ship_fee - log_cost - ship_cost, only eligible unique same-date complete source components

business_origin.note: A connected historical finance worksheet is not independently certified transaction truth.

policy: Unknown units, refund meaning, cost timing and revenue inclusion cannot be inferred from arithmetic, labels or displayed number formats. Do not set unknown values to zero to manufacture complete margins.
